ANT-2026-0HC68EK6: Heap Buffer Overflow via Unsafe static_cast in OOXML VML Textbox Replay

An unsafe static_cast during OOXML VML textbox replay leads to a heap buffer overflow.

Target

Project: libreoffice/core
Discovery: static analysis — not yet dynamically reproduced

Reproduction

This finding was identified by static analysis and has not yet been dynamically reproduced. A trigger input is not included.
